entities.name: Ingibjörg Haraldsdóttir
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ingibjörg Haraldsdóttir was an Icelandic poet and translator. She lived in Cuba from 1970 to 1975 and also lived in the U.S.S.R. for a time. She has had six books of poetry published. In translations she is most known for her work translating Russian and Spanish works. She was born in Reykjavík. In 2002, she was awarded the Icelandic Literary Prize.
